records.text: Loomer tweeted that the SAVE America Act would not pass before the midterms, that Congress had no more bills or votes before then, and that it would be a miracle if Democrats did not take the House and Senate in November.
records.speaker: Laura Loomer

appearances.snippet: who basically are the reason people are not getting out of bed to vote. Because why are we voting for a party that traded Charlie Kirk for Laura Loomer? Like, who's doing that? Who's like, yeah, no, this is totally the same party? And Laura Loomer tweeted this: We won't be getting the SAVE America Act before midterms. Today was the last day in DC, members of Congress until the end of midterms. No more bills, no more votes, no more anything. The president's agenda was not codified before the midterms. Good luck getting voters out. It will be a miracle, ... Miracle if the Democrats don't take the House and the Senate this November. What is it they say?
